_comment: MPL TestServer commons feature-set.json (design 'Feature Configuration'):
the authoritative Feature_Catalog. Each language's server declares the
supported/unsupported half of every feature here in its own feature-config.json;
the union must equal this catalog. Each feature names one keyring or CMM
a Language_Server may implement. Add a feature here together with the
model operations and Tests that exercise it.
NOT TESTED: MPL behavior the Dafny MPL tests cover that has no model operation
or Feature here, and no Tests.
- Hierarchical keyring over DBE suites (TestHierarchyClientDBESuite): the
model has ESDK suites only. The branch key id supplier tests, which the
Dafny MPL runs over a DBE suite, are ported over an ESDK suite.
- The exact IncorrectDataKeys message (TestInvalidDataKeyError): error text
is not portable across implementations; only MPLClientError is asserted.
- Key store operations (CreateKeyStore, CreateKey, VersionKey,
GetActiveBranchKey, GetBranchKeyVersion, GetBeaconKey, GetKeyStoreInfo):
the hierarchical keyring tests read pre-provisioned branch keys; the key
store's own operations are not modeled.
- Materials cache types other than Default, and the keyring's own cache
configuration: a keyring uses either its default cache or a Shared
Default cache passed by handle.
